history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-21, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#580; borg-reborn-rs #831, PR #836; the requester's
proposal adopted as written). Pilot (RULES 16) of the three arms; classes-1800 as in #566 (the two Human Blackguard
deaths, seeds 2078477958 and 2037495442, are in it; Blackguards and Warriors above all, plus a caster class) follows
after the gate and the owner. Three arms, 18 starts each (54 games), all classes.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or
borg_stopped; stalls, timeouts and crashes kept apart: any B or C stall that A does not have is reported start by
start (resting stalls are the risk of the mode); frozen-turn bursts classified.
Primary at the classes-1800 tier: deaths whose killing blow came from an unseen attacker (the last messages
"Something ..."; clear icky thing, poltergeist, ghosts), B against A, paired by start; at 2 such deaths in #566's 1,800
the difference is reported as a count, not tested, and no benefit is claimed. Guard (non-inferiority): total deaths,
B minus A, margin 1 percentage point of starts. Descriptive: deaths by cause; resting stalls and timeouts; gold spent
on Detect Invisible and what it displaced (Cure Light Wounds, Phase Door, flasks) per class; CL and max depth; per arm
the counts of the notes "# Mode: invisible attacker near", "# Striking at", "# Detecting the invisible attacker.",
"# Leaving (an unseen attacker, not found)". A death report with screens for any death in B.
experiment.question: On borg-reborn-rs b3f32a9a (PR #836: main 12c4ce7c plus the "invisible attacker near" mode and the Detect Invisible town value), does the shipped behaviour (B) save the deaths whose killing blow comes from an unseen attacker, without adding deaths or stalls, against the old behaviour (A)? C raises town_invisible_percent to 40.
